sloka: स दक्षिणाम् दिशम् गत्वा महिष्या सह राघव ।तताप परमम् घोरम् विश्वामित्रो महातपाः ॥१-५७-२॥
transliteration: sa dakṣiṇām diśam gatvā mahiṣyā saha rāghava ।tatāpa paramam ghoram viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ ॥1-57-2॥

translations.english: 'O Evilminded one having been refused by the Guru true to his word, how could you bypass him and approach us who are mere off shoots (of the main).
